claimCrv(address).details: Claim CRV for LP token staking from the CRV minter contract

claimFees(address,address).details: Only callable by the operator Booster

params._token: LP token to claim fees for

claimRewards(address).details: Called by operator (Booster) to claim extra rewards

params._gaugeController: Curve Gauge Controller                          Controls liquidity gauges and the issuance of coins through the gauges

deposit(address,address).details: Only can be called by the operator (Booster) once this contract has been          whitelisted by the Curve DAO

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes).details: Snapshot Hub will call this function when a vote is submitted using          snapshot.js on behalf of this contract. Snapshot Hub will call this          function with the hash and the signature of the vote that was cast.

params._hash: Hash of the message that was sent to Snapshot Hub to cast a vote

returns._0: EIP1271 magic value if the signature is value

release().details: Only callable by CrvDepositor and can only withdraw if lock has expired

params._mintr: Token minter address for claiming rewards

params._hash: Hash of vote signature that was sent to snapshot.org

withdraw(address).details: Tokens shouldn't end up here if they can help it. However, dao can          set a withdrawer that can process these to some ExtraRewardDistribution.

params._amount: Amount of LP token to withdraw

claimFees(address,address).notice: Claim fees (3crv) from staking lp tokens

createLock(uint256,uint256).notice: Lock CRV in Curve's voting escrow contract

deposit(address,address).notice: Deposit tokens into the Curve Gauge

increaseAmount(uint256).notice: Called by the CrvDepositor to increase amount of locked curve

increaseTime(uint256).notice: Called by the CrvDepositor to increase unlocked time of curve

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes).notice: Verifies that the hash is valid

release().notice: Withdraw all CRV from Curve's voting escrow contract

setDepositor(address).notice: Set the depositor of the VoterProxy

setOperator(address).notice: Set the operator of the VoterProxy

setRewardDeposit(address,address).notice: Allows dao to set the reward withdrawal address

setSystemConfig(address,address).notice: Allows dao to set the external system config, should it change in the future

setVote(bytes32,bool).notice: Save a vote hash so when snapshot.org asks this contract if           a vote signature is valid we are able to check for a valid hash          and return the appropriate response inline with EIP 1721

vote(uint256,address,bool).notice: Vote on CRV DAO for proposal

voteGaugeWeight(address,uint256).notice: Vote for a single gauge weight via the controller

withdraw(address).notice: Withdraw ERC20 tokens that have been distributed as extra rewards

withdraw(address,address,uint256).notice: Withdraw LP tokens from a gauge

withdrawAll(address,address).notice: Withdraw all LP tokens from a gauge

userdoc.notice: VoterProxy whitelisted in the curve SmartWalletWhitelist that          participates in Curve governance. Also handles all deposits since this is           the address that has the voting power.
